incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED — P0: US‑EAST dedicated pool degraded (increased 5xx on dedicated jobs)
Ryan (oncall): got the page, looking
Julia SRE: I see elevated tail latency on prod-dedicated-01, KV cache misses spiking
Ethan (eng-runtime): rolling back last kernel patch to canary nodes now, ETA ~5m
Ryan (oncall): coordinating paging. Liz can you confirm impacted accounts list?
Liz (acct-ops): pulling account matrix... Falcon Financial (acct-falcon-prod), Meridian Pay (acct-meridian-eu), NovaRetail (acct-nova) — Falcon is on dedicated us-east, heavy traffic
Matt (customer-success): reached out to Falcon AM, they're seeing auth failures and dropped requests, want tailored comms
Ops Coordinator: Oncall handoff note: @Ryan -> please include fallback guidance for customers using private deployment
Julia SRE: mitigation progress: rollback initiated on node group 7/8, traffic being drained from group 8
incident-bot: update 1805000060 — mitigation step: canary rollback started
Ethan (eng-runtime): setting routing policy to route fallback to compatible model variant for Falcon (quantised-v2) while we stabilize
Ryan (oncall): preparing status page copy, draft below — please review
Ryan (oncall): STATUS PAGE (draft):
"We are investigating increased error rates impacting dedicated inference in US‑EAST. Some enterprise customers may experience elevated 5xx errors and timeouts. Engineers are actively rolling back a recent runtime change and routing traffic to fallback model variants. We will provide updates within 15 minutes."
Julia SRE: tweak: add affected timeframe and note that embeddings/low‑latency paths unaffected
Ryan (oncall): updated draft:
"Update: Engineers are rolling back a recent runtime change introduced at 12:07 UTC. Some dedicated workloads in US‑EAST may see 5xx errors and higher latency. Embeddings and low‑latency endpoints are not impacted. We expect restoration within 30 minutes; next update at 12:40 UTC."
Liz (acct-ops): Falcon-specific communication (tailored):
"Hi Falcon team — we’re investigating an issue affecting your dedicated US‑EAST instance causing dropped inference requests and intermittent 5xx errors. Our engineers have rolled back a recent runtime patch and are routing your traffic to a compatible fallback model variant to reduce error rates. We expect service restoration within 30 minutes and will keep you updated every 20 minutes or on major changes. If you need immediate mitigation, enable fallback mode in the console (Routing > Fallbacks) or contact your AM."
Matt (customer-success): ok to send to Falcon AM thread after legal OK; include support case #INC1805
Ops Coordinator: Oncall handoff details for next person:
- current status: rollback in progress, traffic partially rerouted
- actions in flight: restore node group, run KV cache warmup, monitor 5xx rate
- escalation: page eng-runtime lead if >10% 5xx persists beyond 35m
Ethan (eng-runtime): commands used:
```
# drain nodes
k8s scale deployment/prod-dedicated --replicas=3 --namespace=dedicated
# force rollback
infractl rollout undo runtime-patch --to-revision=2026-03-17-12:06
```
Julia SRE: telemetry note: watch prod.dedicated.request.5xx and prod.dedicated.kv_miss.p95
Ryan (oncall): I'll post the status page update and send tailored Falcon message once legal signs off — pinging @Liz for account contact details
Liz (acct-ops): Falcon AM contact: emma@falconfin.com, escalation: emma+oncall@falconfin.com, phone: +1-415-555-0137
incident-bot: update 1805000180 — rollback finished on group 8, traffic routing complete
Ryan (oncall): Observed 5xx dropped from 12.4% -> 1.1% in the last 5 minutes, keeping monitoring
Matt (customer-success): Falcon AM confirmed receipt and asked for ETA on request replay guidance
Ethan (eng-runtime): replay guidance: if using async submit, reduce concurrency to 2 and retry with exponential backoff; they can also switch to fallback quantised-v2 which we've routed to
Julia SRE: closing loop: will keep monitoring for 1h, then file postmortem if recurrence
OPS Coordinator: thanks team — final note: draft postmortem owner @Julia SRE. I'll compile timeline and customer comms for Falcon. :white_check_mark:
Ryan (oncall): moving to resolve channel in 30m unless errors resurge. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:
